title: Simultaneous normalized charts for the embedded sheet lattices
statement: Fix prime l, a finite normed Q_l-extension E that is totally disconnected, and A=continuousIntegers(l,E). Let X be any scheme, P a locally finite free internal E_X-module, p:U→X a finite etale surjection, M a locally finite free internal A_U-module, and e:Ext(A_U→E_U)M≅p*P. There is a pro-etale scheme cover C such that each Y=C_s has a rank r, a positive sheet number d, maps t_j:Y→U with pt_j=g=C.f(s) and a coproduct splitting of U×_X Y given by (t_j,id). There are full A-lattices L_j⊂E^r, each with an A-basis also an E-basis, and a continuous-function presentation c of Res(A_Y→E_Y)g*P with values in E^r. On every B in Y_proet, the range of the encoded actual sheet map of [def-sfb-finite-etale-lattice-sheet-maps], transported through c_B, is exactly the range of C(|B|,L_j)→C(|B|,E^r). No trace or image of a sum is involved.

proof.text: Apply the continuous sheet-matrix coordinates theorem. It supplies finite etale splittings, continuous matrices for the actual sheet embeddings, and rational frames on every open restriction.

The integral subring of E contains the open norm ball around zero and is therefore open as an additive subgroup. Apply continuousMatrixCoset_neighborhood to each of the finitely many matrices at a point and intersect the resulting open neighbourhoods. All sheet cosets are constant on this common open neighbourhood.

For a constant invertible matrix g define its lattice by the condition that g inverse times the vector has all coordinates in A. The map A^r→L given by g and its inverse coordinate map give inverse linear equivalences. Transport the standard integral basis and the standard rational basis; their columns agree. Equal right integral cosets define equal such submodules: integral matrices and their inverses preserve A^r. Thus the variable inverse-coordinate test becomes pointwise membership in each fixed full lattice. The range of continuous functions into a submodule is exactly the functions with pointwise values in it, by the induced topology.

Form the Zariski cover by these common open neighbourhoods, weaken it to a pro-etale cover, and bind it with the matrix-coordinate cover. Use the restricted rational presentation, specified splitting and range equations on each member. Empty X uses the empty cover and the empty-vector argument also treats rank zero.

theorem continuousFiniteEtaleLattice_sheet_charts
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace E] (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (hP : LocallyFree (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) P)
    {U : Scheme.{u}} (p : U ⟶ X) [IsFinite p] [Etale p] [Surjective p]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) U))
    (hM : LocallyFree (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) U) M)
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) U)).obj M ≅
      (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P) :
    ∃ C : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage X, ∀ s : C.I₀,
      ∃ (r d : ℕ) (_ : 0 < d) (t : Fin d → (C.X s ⟶ U))
        (w : ∀ j, t j ≫ p = C.f s),
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback p (C.f s))
          (fun j ↦ pullback.lift (t j) (𝟙 (C.X s)) (by simpa using w j)))) ∧
      ∃ L : Fin d → Submodule (continuousIntegers l E) (Fin r → E),
        (∀ j, ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin r) (continuousIntegers l E) (L j),
          ∃ c : Module.Basis (Fin r) E (Fin r → E), ∀ i, (b i : Fin r → E) = c i) ∧
      ∃ c : ContinuousFunctionPresentation (C.X s) (continuousIntegers l E) (Fin r → E)
          ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) (C.X s))).obj
            ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) (C.f s)).obj P)),
        ∀ (j : Fin d) (B : (C.X s).ProEt),
          Set.range (fun x ↦ c.sections B
            (((continuousRingModuleEquivalence (C.X s) (continuousIntegers l E)).functor.map
              (finiteEtaleLatticeSheetEmbedding (integralScalarMap l E) P p M e
                (C.f s) (t j) (w j))).val.app (op B) x)) =
            Set.range (continuousLatticeInclusion (continuousIntegers l E) (L j) B.left)
